title: Friendship Tax Escape Calculator
oneLiner: A playful social-budget simulator that shows the true cost of weddings, trips, outfits, gifts, and the emotional price of saying no.
targetUser: Wedding guests, bridesmaids/groomsmen, friend groups in their late 20s and 30s, and budget-constrained people afraid to look cheap or unsupportive.
keyUx: Enter upcoming weddings, trips, roles, flights, hotels, outfits, gifts, PTO, partner costs, and relationship closeness; visualize the friendship tax, rank obligations by emotional risk, suggest graceful boundary scripts, and generate a shareable budget card.
externalSignals: Reddit r/AmIOverreacting wedding guest cost anxiety — https://www.reddit.com/r/AmIOverreacting/comments/1quzxw2/aio_overwhelmed_by_the_cost_of_being_a_wedding/
Reddit r/weddingplanning bridesmaid/wedding participation frustration — https://www.reddit.com/r/weddingplanning/
stitchPrompt: Design a playful social-budget product called Friendship Tax Escape Calculator for wedding guests, bridesmaids and groomsmen, friend groups in their late 20s and 30s, and budget-constrained people afraid to look cheap or unsupportive. Users should enter upcoming weddings, trips, roles, flights, hotels, outfits, gifts, PTO, partner costs, and relationship closeness, then visualize the friendship tax, rank obligations by emotional risk, suggest graceful boundary scripts, and generate a shareable “I love you, but here is my budget” card. Include an event obligation intake, total friendship-tax calculator, closeness versus cost map, emotional-risk meter, boundary script generator, alternative support menu, and shareable budget card. Design direction: use a playful-experimental aesthetic with bold receipt-collage visuals, soft social-anxiety humor, colorful obligation tokens, expressive meters, and a memorable share card so the app feels like a portfolio-worthy confession booth for friendship money stress rather than a boring budget spreadsheet.
